sources.label: defi.money documentation: how MONEY is made

reserveReview.rationale: Bound to the live money-llamma adapter and restated on its exact bucket identities: a 2026-09-09 multicall census of the defi.money controller across Arbitrum (block 503468467), Base (51096679), and Optimism (156691968) enumerated 12 LLAMMA market operators and read 9,853 bands, pricing bands_x/bands_y collateral through DefiLlama quotes. The former unpublished-basket envelope (ku=100) is replaced by the four measured buckets the adapter emits; weights refresh at runtime with each reserve sync.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Live money-llamma adapter bucket identities and capture-time weights from the 2026-09-09 on-chain LLAMMA band census across Arbitrum, Base, and Optimism
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: All four live collateral buckets are identified at the capture census; the accepted-collateral set changes with market usage, and any newly accepted symbol surfaces as an additional measured money-llamma:other-<symbol> bucket at runtime rather than hiding inside a reviewed row.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: Native ETH held in LLAMMA bands is external crypto collateral, not a tracked stablecoin dependency.
Lido wstETH is external crypto collateral, not a tracked stablecoin dependency.
Custodied Bitcoin wrappers are external crypto collateral, not tracked stablecoin dependencies.
cbBTC and any further accepted collateral symbols are external crypto assets measured per symbol at runtime, not tracked stablecoin dependencies.

custodyProfile.reviewer: Kimi P2 reserve cohort rc-5 (lead ylds-figure)
custodyProfile.uncertainty: Collateral is held by the protocol's immutable LLAMMA market contracts rather than a legal custodian; the reviewed sources establish the deployment registry but no legal segregation, insolvency treatment, or reuse terms. The issuer frontend is disabled as of 2026-07-20, limiting further verification.
